# Expected cross-file edges for the Python fixture: kind<TAB>from<TAB>to.
# A leading `?` marks an allowed-but-not-required edge.

# ── app.py ──
# `import pkg.core`
Imports	app.py	pkg/core.py
# `from pkg.util import tool as t` → the package's __init__.py.
Imports	app.py	pkg/util/__init__.py
# `from pkg.extra import *`
Imports	app.py	pkg/extra.py
# pkg.core.compute() through the module import.
Calls	app.py	pkg/core.py
# t() → `tool`, re-exported by pkg/util/__init__.py from .tools.
Calls	app.py	pkg/util/tools.py
# star_fn() through the glob import.
Calls	app.py	pkg/extra.py
# `os` is external; local_helper() is local.

# ── pkg/util/__init__.py ──
Imports	pkg/util/__init__.py	pkg/util/tools.py

# ── pkg/sub.py ──
# `from .core import compute as c2` and c2().
Imports	pkg/sub.py	pkg/core.py
Calls	pkg/sub.py	pkg/core.py
